scientific_integrity: Uniform proof by exact simplicial decomposition, integral orientation determinant and genuine finite-group quotient; finite verification checks explicit cases only. No external independent audit or certification.
scientific_limitations: Applies to vertex-metric scale two on one-edge-spined hexagon books with at least two arms; no higher-scale or Borel quotient classification. The nonequivariant wedge is covered by general short-path gluing results. Possible unindexed equivalent equivariant work remains.
title: Integral arm-permutation homology and sphere quotients of one-edge hexagon books
